rows.response_text: To adjust vertical blinds, start by removing the end cap from the head rail using a flathead screwdriver. Locate the vane carrier within the head rail and tap lightly on the end of the rod to loosen the pulley. Pull on the vane carrier firmly and use your free hand to pull the extra cord to adjust the length of the vertical blind chain. Once you have reached the desired length, tie a knot in the cord to secure it. Finally, replace the end cap and the blinds should be adjusted.
